settings.sidebar-icons-per-rowTip: The number of icons per row to use for the right sidebar when the Tabs On Top setting is enabled.  13 is the default, for the 13 core buttons in one row.
settings.tabs-on-topTip: Move the right sidebar tabs to horizontal tabs on top of the sidebar when it is expanded.
settings.no-compendium-backgroundTip: Remove the default compendium backgrounds and tighten up the display some.
settings.tighten-appv2Tip: Reduce unnecessary whitespace in the Application V2 apps introduced with V12/V13.
settings.adjust-left-sidebarTip: Adjust the sizing, spacing, and styling of the left sidebar layer controls to be closer to the pre-V13 styling.
settings.chat-backgroundTip: Enable a background for the chat tab of the sidebar, similar to the other sidebar tabs.
settings.adjust-hotbarTip: Tweak the hotbar styling to move it closer to the left and prevent it from collapsing into two rows.
